typicalBarText: Early-career intake bar focuses on core CS fundamentals, data structures & algorithms problem-solving track record, competitive coding profiles (LeetCode/Codeforces), academic consistency (CGPA), and demonstrable projects or internship exposure. Non-CS candidates are expected to bridge core operating systems and networks coursework.
checklistItems: Core CS fundamentals or degree coursework in algorithms and operating systems
At least 2 substantial technical projects with public code repositories or live links
Active competitive coding profile (LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank) or GitHub presence
expectedSignals: Core CS fundamentals or degree coursework
Clear programming language proficiency with code samples or links

scoredSignals.label: Internships & Practical Training
scoredSignals.description: Formal internship, co-op, or industry training experience demonstrating collaborative codebase work.

scoredSignals.label: Competitive Coding & Platform Profiles
scoredSignals.description: Active coding profiles (LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, GitHub) demonstrating problem-solving persistence.

scoredSignals.label: Academic Performance & Coursework Consistency
scoredSignals.description: Documented CGPA, GPA, percentage, or academic honors reflecting academic rigor.

scoredSignals.label: Core CS Fundamentals & Branch Alignment
scoredSignals.description: Degree coursework or explicit coverage of Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, DBMS, and Computer Networks.

adviceCards.title: Add Formal Internship or Open-Source Experience
adviceCards.recommendation: Add formal internships, co-ops, or open-source fellowship contributions to validate collaborative delivery in production teams.

adviceCards.title: Link Verified Coding Profiles
adviceCards.recommendation: Link active competitive coding profiles (LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank) or GitHub with solved DSA problems to prove algorithmic mastery.

adviceCards.title: Highlight Core CS Fundamentals Coursework
adviceCards.recommendation: Non-CS engineering backgrounds must explicitly highlight core CS coursework (Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, DBMS, Networks) to pass technical screening.

adviceCards.title: Include Academic Record or Distinction
adviceCards.recommendation: List degree CGPA / aggregate percentage if above 7.0/10 (or 3.0/4.0); otherwise emphasize high-impact open source repositories and contest rankings.
